name: comp-245
title: Slider Reference Labels
description: A horizontal slider for a size in gigabytes, with the filled range in white ahead of a round thumb and three grey labels marking the low, middle and high end beneath it.
use: When a number in a range is set by feel and the ends plus midpoint should stay visible.
avoid: No live number follows the thumb, so the exact value is only implied by its position between the labels.
a11y: The slider exposes its value and range and takes arrow keys, but the GB labels are hidden from assistive tech, so the unit is never spoken. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white heading sits over a long thin track whose left stretch is white and right stretch dark grey, with a round white thumb ringed in dark. Three grey labels, 5 GB, 20 GB and 35 GB, are spread evenly under the track.
behaves: Dragging the thumb slides it along the track and the white fill follows it exactly; the labels below never move. The clip drags the thumb past the middle and lets it settle.
customise: The range, the starting value and the three labels are written in the file; edit them there. Track height, thumb size and colours come from the shared slider styles.
weight: light: One native range input drawn by the shared slider styles, with no animation.
demo: Slider with reference labels; 5 GB, 20 GB and 35 GB marks
issues: No number is shown at the thumb, so the exact gigabytes must be judged from its position.
The reference labels are hidden from screen readers while being the only place the unit appears.
polishWhy: Clear track and evenly spaced labels; otherwise a stock slider with no live value.
